text:
jess: FYI I found a mismatch in the Rerank API docs: examples show `candidate_scores` as a single float per request, but the runtime expects an array of floats that aligns with `candidates`. This caused the JS SDK integration test to fail.

tom: Oof. Where is the bad example?
jess: File: docs/api-ref/endpoints/rerank.md and snippets: docs/snippets/json/rerank_example.json
jess: Current example body in rerank.md:
```json
{
  "query": "find best match",
  "candidates": ["a","b","c"],
  "candidate_scores": 0.87
}
```

jess: Should be:
```json
{
  "query": "find best match",
  "candidates": ["a","b","c"],
  "candidate_scores": [0.72, 0.87, 0.65]
}
```
anika: Good catch. The OpenAPI schema already defines candidate_scores: array[number], so this is just a docs/example generator issue. Could be an old template that collapses singletons.
kevin: Can you add a short note in the param docs that lengths must match and what we do if lengths differ (server returns 400 with error.code = "invalid_argument")? That prevents subtle bugs.
jess: Yes. I'll add: "candidate_scores must be an array of numbers with the same length as candidates; otherwise a 400 error is returned (see error.code/error.message)." Also adding an example of omitting scores to let server score automatically.
tom: Nice. Also include a tiny SDK migration snippet for folks who previously sent a single score: `if typeof candidate_scores === 'number' then candidate_scores = candidates.map(() => candidate_scores)` — so older clients can choose to broadcast a score.
anika: Update the rerank snippet generator template too — it was flattening numeric arrays if length==1. I'll open a quick fix.
docs-bot: PR created by @jess: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/9120 reviewers: @anika @tom
kevin: Reviewed and left a nit on wording for the broadcast example.
jess: Fixed wording, added an explicit error example for 400 payload with `error.code: "invalid_argument"` and `error.message`. Also updated docs/snippets/py/rerank_example.py to show parsing the array response and validating lengths.
tom: LGTM, approving in GH.
anika: I patched the snippet generator template in a separate tiny PR so this won't regress.
docs-bot: PRs merged by @jess: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/commits/main?after=9120 :tada:
jess: Merged. I'll add a short changelog entry and ping eng-qa to re-run the rerank integration tests. Thanks folks! :shipit:
